esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; Water pressure transducer 0-1.2 MPa needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OUT → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 33 kΩ / 68 kΩ divider on OUT: it swings to 5 V, and the D32 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the pressure_transducer.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the pressure set on the slider: passes
